3. Rate and Billing

As the items of the MDUS request match the billing order (no billing-relevant changes), the order can be billed. In the first

rate step, the RTP operand CONS OFFPEAK adds together all the consumption values of the MDUS request used by the
result parameter OFFPEAK and multiplies the total consumption by a price: (118 kWh + 169 kWh + 201 kWh) x 0,16. The
remaining rate steps follow.

Simulation of Time-of-Use Billing

Use

The time-of-use interface provides you with a simulation mode that you can use to simulate billing of externally saved profile
values in SAP for Utilities.

The following forms of simulation are supported:

e Budget billing simulation (for example for a move-in) except in the express transaction Change Budget Billing Amount
(transactionEA61EX)

e Billing simulation without a billable billing order

Prerequisites

You have activated the business function Utilities, Advanced Metering Infrastructure 4 (ISU AMI 4) and also made the
following settings in Customizing and in the SAP menu:
